hero.title: Curtains tailored to every window
hero.subtitle: Pick a style, enter your size and see the estimate instantly. We survey, tailor and install at your home.

steps.title: Three steps to your new curtains

one.title: Choose and measure
one.text: Pick the style, fabric and pleat, then enter the width and height of your window.

two.text: The price updates as you type, based on your size and options.

three.title: Survey and installation
three.text: Send the order on Zalo or book a survey. We re-measure, tailor and install.
